purpose: What this record read of other people's work, and when. Every statement in the README or results/ about what another lab has or has not run holds as of that lab's 'compared' entry here, not as of today. Rendered to results/ledger_snapshots.md by src/ledger_watch.py --render; checked against the live repositories by src/ledger_watch.py.
pin_note: The reads of October 2026 recorded dates, round numbers and row counts, not commit hashes. Each 'compared' commit below is the last commit on the branch on or before the read date, looked up on 2026-11-25 from the public commit history; a rewritten history would change it. The 'seen' commits were read directly on 2026-11-25.
